spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates deriving multiple alpha levels from one brand token via alpha(from var(--brand)), with an honest '⚠ not supported, panels use fallback rgba()' banner on this build.

interactive.rationale: The brand color input re-derives all three glass panels in lockstep and echoes the current --brand value.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised single-origin layered compositor.

edge_cases.rationale: Fallback is honest, but only the happy derivation path is explored — no out-of-gamut or alpha-clamping cases.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: page rendered the three panels with the fallback banner and live --brand readout; zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: 21 var() usages; single hex is the default brand color.

accessibility.rationale: The color input is labelled, but panel alpha differences are visual-only with no text equivalent of the derived values per panel.

openQuestions.title: Expose each panel's derived color as text
openQuestions.detail: Panels A/B/C show 70/45/20% alpha visually; printing the computed rgba()/alpha() value under each panel would give a non-visual equivalent and double as evidence when alpha() goes live.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: brand-color input drives all three glass layers with the fallback honestly labelled ('⚠ Relative alpha colors not supported... Panels use fallback rgba()'); zero console errors.
